chunks: In case he divorces you, his Lord will give him better wives in return, who will be modest, true believers, obedient to God, repentant, observant of prayer and fasting, both widows and virgins.
ai.seo_question: What qualities will the wives Allah provides replace a divorced man's ex-wives with?
ai.summary: In the context of the Prophet's divorce from Zaynab bint Jahsh, this verse reassures him that Allah will provide him with spouses superior in faith and devotion, specifically highlighting the qualities of *qanat* (obedient to God), *ta'ib* (repentant), and *'abid* (worshipper). Shia scholarship emphasizes that the inclusion of both *thayyibat* (previously married) and *abkar** (virgins) signifies the universality of these spiritual virtues across different marital statuses, serving as a model for the Ummah.
